caption: Sausages sizzle in a hot pan, and one of them splits open along its side with a pop.

sa.check: Sausages lie in a hot pan.
One sausage splits along its side.
The split does not close again.

pc.expect: The split only opens wider and stays open, and the juices only leave.
pc.fail: The split closes and the skin is whole again; or the split narrows; or the juices draw back into the sausage; or the split opens and shuts in turn.

pc.expect: The skin stays a casing that bursts along a line and gapes, and the sausage keeps being one sausage.
pc.fail: The sausage melts and drips; or the skin stretches like rubber and stays whole while gaping; or the sausage splits into two whole sausages; or the sausage turns into another object.

pc.expect: The juices run down the sausage into the pan and gather at its low places, and the sausages rest in the pan.
pc.fail: The juices climb up the sausage; or a drop leaves the sausage and rises; or a sausage lifts off the pan and hangs; or the juices gather on the sausage's top and stay.

pc.expect: The sausages shift only as the pan is moved, as they split or as the fat spits.
pc.fail: A sausage slides across the pan with the pan still and no split; or a sausage rolls uphill; or the sausages line themselves up in a row; or a sausage spins fast on the spot.

pc.expect: The sausages keep their number in the pan and none appears or vanishes.
pc.fail: A sausage vanishes; or a new sausage appears in the pan; or two sausages merge into one; or a sausage passes through the pan's floor.

pc.expect: The pan, the hob and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The pan changes colour; or its handle changes shape; or items around the hob rearrange.

note: The pop is sound and is not judged. The sausages browning as they cook is chemistry and is not judged.
